import sys, copy, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
def check(prof, cert):
    cal=para.Calibration(prof)
    return algo._check_calibration_certificate(cal, cert)
# 1. our own
prof={'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[1,2,3],'measurements':[[0,1,1,3],[1,2,2,4],[0,2,3,7]]}
cal=para.Calibration(prof)
art=cal.artifact()
print('own cert:', check(prof,art))
# 2. break a witness
c=copy.deepcopy(art); c['pred'][0][2]=99
print('bad witness id:', check(prof,c))
# 3. wrong weight sum: change the upper value
c=copy.deepcopy(art); c['upper_ps'][0][2]=c['upper_ps'][0][2]+1
print('wrong upper:', check(prof,c))
# 4. infeasible row
c=copy.deepcopy(art); c['upper_ps'][0][1]=50
print('infeasible row:', check(prof,c))
# 5. non-zero diagonal
c=copy.deepcopy(art); c['upper_ps'][1][1]=7
print('nonzero diagonal:', check(prof,c))
# 6. pred diagonal not null
c=copy.deepcopy(art); c['pred'][0][0]=0
print('pred diagonal:', check(prof,c))
# 7. alternative witness: profile with two equal shortest paths
prof2={'groups':3,'jitter_ps':[0,0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,1,1],[1,2,1,1],[0,2,2,2]]}
cal2=para.Calibration(prof2); art2=cal2.artifact()
print('prof2:', json.dumps(art2))
print('own cert2:', check(prof2,art2))
# alternative witness for (0,2): the direct edge 4 instead of the two-hop path
c=copy.deepcopy(art2)
print('edges:', cal2.edges)
c['pred'][0][2]=4   # the direct measurement (0,2) upper constraint
print('alternative witness (direct):', check(prof2,c))
EOF
